title: Signature Finding: The Cheapest Test
description: Manon's cheapest-test principle: for every hypothesis, ask 'what is the cheapest test that could kill it?' — and run that first. Expensive tests are for surviving hypotheses, not newborn ones. It inverts the instinct to prove and replaces it with the discipline to disprove cheaply. Signature original.

title: Signature Finding: The 24-Hour Rule
description: Manon's 24-hour rule: write the finding within 24 hours of the observation — details decay exponentially, and the finding you write tomorrow is a worse finding. Field notes beat memory; timestamped notes beat field notes. The rule's corollary: the best time to document is now. Signature original.

title: Signature Finding: The Comparison Set

'Boring first' is the method's motto — most anomalies are mundane, and the method finds the mundane fast. Signature original.
